observations.message: The selected EVI bundle passed the configured evidence verification gate.
Compiler and source-integrity states are reported from the sealed evidence manifest.
Common message identities across L5-L12 and per-layer message counts are measured from the evidence index.
Per-layer counts outside the L5-L12 common message intersection are reported without causal interpretation.
Requested and allowed L9 velocity magnitudes are compared tick by tick.
L12 safety-decision, reason, latch, enable and output counts are reported from normalized evidence.
Rows containing recovery/fault/stop/resume/degradation/lifecycle state tokens are counted by evidence view.
L8 requested linear/angular velocities are classified by explicit numeric thresholds.
Localization-related fields are profiled across L1-L4 and localization-relevant materialized sensor views.
Wheel-target, normalized-actuator and final-output zero/nonzero/sign relationships are counted independently per layer.
World-model related fields are profiled across L3-L6; raw-LiDAR materialization is counted without scanning every point.
Normalized-view totals from the evidence index and coverage artifact are compared.
DIAG consumed the EVI bundle and did not reopen the source MCAP.
Observed value-change counts are reported for lifecycle-related fields in time order.
